question: Can terminal outcomes from the frozen random-material selfplay support a material-ratio gradient even when tiny candidate tournaments give no unambiguous winner?
changed_premise: Separate outcome regression, not extra matches/extension of task096. Use already frozen TRAIN matches only; censored games excluded with rates reported. No old heldout reads for model selection.
features: P/N/B/R/Q owner0-minus-owner1 counts, from independent PythonChess replay of every8th post-opening ply with halfmove_clock>=4; exclude terminal positions. All samples from each terminal game share its actual Core terminal outcome, total weight per game1. Quietness is a predeclared observational filter, not causal validation.
labels: white win1, black win0, true terminal draw0.5 only; nonterminal cutoff no label/no bootstrap.
objective: sigmoid((208*deltaP+sum(w[j]*delta[j]))/1040), no intercept; fit four logratios. Fixed P=208 and temperature1040 for finite numerical scale, not human ratios. Positive logweights clippedlog(.25)..log(16); mean gameweighted crossentropy; no regularization or shrinkage prior, no human target.
update: All three task096 initial theta; deterministic fullbatch100 gradient steps, learning_rate0.1. No line search/earlybest/epoch tuning; output finalstep only.
evaluation: Training objective is descriptive, not evidence of playing gain. After fit final vs initial on4 NEW random8ply openings seeds30000..30003, bothcolors, sameNative512node/maxdepth8/q0/160ply; eachgame fresh4MiB engines; total24games. Never feed results back into model.
heldout_exposure: Prior task096 heldout is not used for fitting or selection; new24matches genuinely unseen under this model protocol, development evidence rather than population guarantee.
cost: Existing data replay and stdlib gradients;24newboundedmatches expected1-3min, fixed600second stageguard. No >1hrun, no extra workers/defaults/rules/NNUE.
design_review: Before execution remove proposed unit-ratio shrinkage: every weight update must derive from actual outcome gradients, not a hidden equal-price prior.
